ruleDefinitions.name: Firewall Configuration Discovery Via Netsh.EXE
ruleDefinitions.description: Adversaries may look for details about the network configuration and settings of systems they access or through information discovery of remote systems

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\netsh\\\.exe$") OR process_original_file_name = "netsh\.exe") AND ((process_command_line = RGX(".*netsh\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*show\\ .*") AND process_command_line = RGX(".*firewall\\ .*")) AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*config\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*state\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*rule\\ .*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*name\\=all.*"))))
